body:
### Problem
On the System Review page, the Schedules, Past reviews and Log tabs show `E7001 command refused at task unknown route` instead of their content.

### Cause
`board::server.root_route` lists the routes the root answers itself (`projects_api`). It is missing `/system-reviews` and everything under `/system-reviews/`. When the workspace root is itself a project (as Solace's own is), `Board::route` sends those requests to the root project's `board::server.api`, which doesn't know them and answers `unknown route`. The routes themselves exist in `Board::projects_api`; their tests call `projects_api` directly, so they never went through `route` and missed this.

The same gap likely affects starting a review from Run Review and the missed-review notice (`/system-reviews/missed`) on the System Review and Delivery pages.

### Done when
- `root_route` answers `/system-reviews` and every path under `/system-reviews/`.
- A test sends each System Review route through `Board::route` with the root as a project and checks it reaches the root, not the root project.
- Past reviews, Log, Schedules, starting a review and the missed-review notice work on a workspace whose root is a project.
title: sysreview: route review requests to the root
